UPDATE books SET 
  retailPrice = CASE 
    WHEN seriesOrder = 1 THEN 499
    WHEN seriesOrder = 2 THEN 499
    WHEN seriesOrder = 3 THEN 599
    WHEN seriesOrder = 0 THEN 299
    ELSE 499
  END,
  directPrice = CASE 
    WHEN seriesOrder = 1 THEN 399
    WHEN seriesOrder = 2 THEN 399
    WHEN seriesOrder = 3 THEN 499
    WHEN seriesOrder = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE 399
  END,
  memberPrice = CASE 
    WHEN seriesOrder = 1 THEN 299
    WHEN seriesOrder = 2 THEN 299
    WHEN seriesOrder = 3 THEN 399
    WHEN seriesOrder = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE 299
  END
WHERE series = 'Manhattan Money Kings';
